name: Support
summary: Weekdays: reads new customer issues from the source you name (read only), groups duplicates, maps each to its likely code path, and posts a proposal card with a ticket draft and a reply draft. Never sends a reply.

source.label: Where customer issues come from: jira:<project key> or teams:<channel> (empty = nothing is read)

maxIssues.label: Most issues posted as cards per run

outputs.label: Triaged issue with ticket and reply drafts
